fact: Digital Earth Africa and SASSCAL agreed to build the AgriWatch dashboard on DE Africa Earth-observation products for crop-cycle, rangeland and rainfall monitoring, with AgriWatch covering this country among the six SASSCAL states.

GGPEN, under the telecoms ministry, and Portuguese firm GEOSAT signed a letter of intent to develop geospatial solutions for strategic sectors including agriculture and forestry under the ANGEO-1 programme.

The National Space Program's Earth observation component, built around the ANGEO-1 satellite, is described as focused on environmental monitoring, precision agriculture, natural resource management and disaster prevention.
